title: 003 Aircraft Selection: implementation task list
body:
## Summary

`speckit-tasks` output for feature 003 (follows #22): `specs/003-aircraft-selection/tasks.md`, 24 tasks organised by user story, tests-before-implementation per Constitution III.

- **Phase 1 Setup (T001–T003)**: `tests/sim/aircraft.test.ts` → `src/sim/aircraft.ts` (six pure `AircraftType` records, `footprintScale`, `stepSpin`), `CONTEXT.md` terms.
- **Phase 2 Foundation (T004–T007)**: session aircraft axis (`aircraftSelection`/`activeAircraft`, `aircraftType` on request, `aircraftType`+`spinPhase` on snapshot); `src/render/aircraft.ts` with the six approved builders (H3, L1, F5, P1, B4, G2) and Theme-driven lights; WebGL smoke extended to all six.
- **US1 (T008–T010, MVP)**: Light Plane wired into `main.ts` with spinner phase, `plane.ts` deleted, allocation audit.
- **US2 (T011–T017)**: nine preview cards (`ThemeCard | AircraftCard`), Aircraft radiogroup, keyed `setCardImage`, 18-combination browser scenario.
- **US3 (T018–T020)**: snapshot restore of aircraft + spinner phase, no catch-up, failure/abandoned-launch paths.
- **Polish (T021–T024)**: delete the visual study files, budgets, PR captures, owner device acceptance.

Parallel groups and story dependencies are listed at the end of the file. No runtime code changes in this PR.

### Constitution Check
- Budgets: docs only, no runtime change. Tests: none touched. Dependencies: none. Removed: nothing removed.
